plan.title: A short reflection and a tester who's done talking: no dragging it out, straight to the next step

transcript.text: [voice: Done, three sets of eight push-ups and twelve squats.]
Nice, Theo! Day 3 done, and you went up to 8 push-ups and 12 squats 💪 How did those sets feel? Was the last set of push-ups a grind, or did you have more in the tank?
it was fine, legs were tired on the last set
Tired legs on the last set is normal, and it tells me something useful. Did your push-ups feel steady all three sets, or did they start to slow down too?

Got it, Theo. Since your legs were feeling it, tomorrow we hold steady: 3 sets of 8 push-ups and 12 squats in the living room at 6:30 pm, same as today. Let your body lock this level in before we go up. Work for you?
Locked in, Theo. Tomorrow at 6:30 pm, living room, same 3 sets. Rest those legs tonight, and send me the voice note when you're done 💪
